words.prose: {{ar:رَفَعْنَاهُ}} ({{tr:rafaʿnāhu}}) is the ayah's compressed role-map: the divine subject is carried by {{ar:نَا}} ({{tr:nā}}), the object by {{ar:هُ}} ({{tr:hu}}), and no intermediary is named. The suffix carries Idris across from 19:56, but his grammatical role changes from described figure to recipient of divine action. The simple Form I perfect is enough to bear the full load: completed divine action, concrete lifting, and honorific elevation all sit in one compact verb. The root keeps physical lifting and rank-elevation together; the following destination phrase prevents the verb from becoming only a reputation term, while the honorific context prevents it from being mere movement. A narrower presentation-before-higher-presence pressure also survives, but the verse does not specify a ceremonial scene. The perfect verb presents the elevation as accomplished, and its verb-first position makes the unnamed station arrive as the result of the act. The clause also creates a local elevation arc: this verb names the raising action, and the final adjective supplies the high quality reached. Wider r-f-ʿ passages sharpen the local profile: 2:93 has a mountain raised over a people, 4:158 has a person raised by God without an ordinary destination, and 35:10 contrasts mediated ascent with this direct divine agency. Even the sound remains a secondary support, with the verb moving from contact into open articulation before the long divine subject marker.

words.prose: {{ar:مَكَانًا}} ({{tr:makānan}}) is the hinge between the completed raising and the final quality. Attachment evidence strongly licenses it as an accusative place adverbial governed by the verb, while the CRITICAL second-object pressure survives as a compressed station-reading: the act does not merely move Idris somewhere, it assigns him an elevated station. The following adjective is locked to this noun, so loftiness belongs to the destination phrase rather than becoming a separate predicate for Idris. Its indefiniteness matters: there is no article, possession, or named destination, so the place is grammatically real and deliberately withheld. Because the noun comes from the k-w-n field and appears as a place-form rather than an abstract status word, it lets rank be expressed through situated being. The local pairing is compact: the raising verb governs a being/place noun, and the height adjective immediately qualifies it. Surah 19 already uses place-language at 19:16, 19:22, and 19:75, but here the place-word is no scene setting; it is the result of divine raising. The paired accusative tanwīn on the noun and adjective also makes the destination phrase arrive as one audible unit.

words.prose: {{ar:عَلِيًّا}} ({{tr:ʿaliyyan}}) closes the ayah by naming the quality of the station. Its accusative masculine singular agreement keeps the loftiness attached to {{ar:مَكَانًا}} ({{tr:makānan}}), not to Idris as a free predicate and not to a direct divine-name reading. The faʿīl adjective makes height a settled quality of the destination, while its indefinite form keeps that destination unnamed and unranked against alternatives. The divine-register echo is real but restrained: the wording resonates with the divine-name field attested at 4:34, 31:30, and 42:4, yet the local word remains an indefinite adjective of the station. The ʿ-l-w versus ʿ-l-y derivational pressure likewise remains a lexical pressure around height and exalted naming, not a replacement for the local adjective syntax. The word also completes the local elevation arc: {{ar:رَفَعْنَاهُ}} ({{tr:rafaʿnāhu}}) gives the act of raising, and {{ar:عَلِيًّا}} ({{tr:ʿaliyyan}}) gives the final high quality. Its final position matters: after agent, object, and place have been established, the ayah lands on loftiness itself, with paired tanwīn and the doubled yāʾ giving the closing adjective extra audible weight. Surah 19 has already closed an honorific gift with {{ar:عَلِيًّا}} ({{tr:ʿaliyyan}}) at 19:50, and 19:58 immediately answers this height field with prostrating bodies, so the final adjective becomes both closure and bridge. The contrasts sharpen the choice: 3:55 can use above-language for elevation, and 35:10 can speak of ascent toward God, but 19:57 closes with a qualitative adjective for one prophet's station.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 1-3 form a transitive raising, a place noun, and a high adjective.
baseline_models.mechanism: The raising transfers the object from a prior locus; place supplies the destination, and high fixes its vertical relation.

activation_trace.role: Concrete lifting supplies upward transfer from one locus to another.
Place or position supplies the resulting destination.
Vertical elevation specifies the destination as above its prior level.

changed_reading.before: A nonspecific statement that he was raised.
changed_reading.after: A concrete relocation in which he is made to occupy an upper place.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Each of the three focus roots independently permits rank or standing rather than geometry alone.
baseline_models.mechanism: Honor-bearing raising acts on a place understood as standing, while high marks distinction of rank; the three terms mutually reinforce social or evaluative elevation.

activation_trace.role: Elevation of worth supplies promotion rather than bodily motion.
The place noun can function as position, standing, or degree.
Honor and nobility define the value-axis of the elevation.

changed_reading.before: He was moved to a high coordinate.
changed_reading.after: He was promoted into an exceptionally honored standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus raising verb at word 1 has a publicity branch, while words 2-3 support standing and honor.
baseline_models.mechanism: Making a report manifest can raise a person by making his standing publicly and durably high, even without specifying a physical destination.

activation_trace.role: Making news manifest supplies public propagation as a mode of raising.
Standing supplies what is publicly elevated.
High honor supplies the public standing's quality.

changed_reading.before: The raising is private relocation or promotion.
changed_reading.after: The raising may also be the public elevation of his remembered standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate command to remember and register the focus figure, together with the earlier high truthful tongue, turns publicity into a coherent textual-social mechanism: he is durably placed high in transmitted memory.

activation_trace.role: Publicizing a report anchors remembered elevation in the focus verb.
Standing supplies the durable position produced by public memory.
Honor supplies the value carried by that remembered position.
Honorable reputation makes the command to remember a status-bearing act.
Entry into a register supplies durable textual placement.
Language and speech provide the medium in which elevated standing circulates.
The same high adjective already qualifies a truthful tongue, directly linking height to reputation.

structural_cues: 19:56 immediately introduces the focus figure through remembering and the book.
19:50 applies the same high adjective to a truthful tongue rather than to terrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembrance, registration, speech, and repeated high wording; I infer that transmission can perform the raising. Literal relocation remains a live coexisting alternative.

changed_reading.before: His high standing is asserted but its social medium is unspecified.
changed_reading.after: His standing is raised through durable inscription, truthful speech, and honorable remembrance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby formulas join elevated ground, intimate counsel, favored nearness, presence before sovereignty, and approval. They recast a high place as an admitted station of access, not merely altitude.

activation_trace.role: Presentation or advancement before authority anchors the access model in the focus verb.
Standing or position supplies the admitted station.
High honor marks that station as privileged.
Favored nearness to a ruler supplies privileged access.
Elevated safe ground preserves a spatial image inside the relational formula.
Confidential discourse turns nearness into intimate access.
Presence with another supplies the relational location.
Sovereignty identifies the authority relative to whom standing matters.
Acceptance supplies the evaluative result of presence before that authority.

structural_cues: 19:52 and 19:57 share first-person-plural perfect verbs, object pronouns, and final indefinite descriptors.
19:55 places an approved person in a relation of presence with his Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the grammatical parallels and the spatial-relational branch pair; I infer that height can encode admitted proximity and approval. A geographic high place remains materially possible.

changed_reading.before: The high place is a remote coordinate or abstract rank.
changed_reading.after: The high place is also a privileged station of nearness, audience, and approved presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah gathers the focus figure into a blessed, prophetic, guided, and selected company. Place therefore gains a taxonomic and social function: elevation is bestowed placement within an elect lineage and role.

activation_trace.role: Promotion anchors the focus as bestowed rank.
Position or standing permits placement within a distinguished company.
Honor marks the company's placement as elevated.
Bestowed good condition frames the elevation as gift rather than self-attainment.
Prophetic office supplies the named company into which the focus figure is gathered.
Gentle direction toward the true way supplies directed inclusion.
Selection joined to drawing near supplies deliberate placement among the chosen.

structural_cues: The demonstrative opening of 19:58 immediately gathers the preceding named figures into one described class.
The focus figure's prophetic label in 19:56 is repeated as the class label in 19:58.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate grouping, blessing, guidance, and selection; I infer that the focus place can be corporate standing. The alternative is that 19:58 classifies persons without defining the place in 19:57.

changed_reading.before: The elevation is an isolated distinction granted only to the focus figure.
changed_reading.after: His high place also locates him within a guided, chosen, and blessed prophetic company.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate move from divine raising to the chosen figures' falling, abasement, and weeping creates a vertical reversal: bestowed elevation manifests in voluntary lowering and is thereby distinguished from self-exalting domination.

activation_trace.role: Granted honor supplies the upward half of the reversal.
The root's domineering self-elevation branch supplies the nearby contrast that prostration checks.
Audible, forceful falling supplies the downward motion opposite raising.
Deliberate abasement turns descent into a posture of submission.
Tears and voiced grief make the lowering affective rather than merely geometric.

structural_cues: The high-place clause closes 19:57 and the explicit falling clause closes the immediately following 19:58.
The subject of the falling is the selected group into which 19:58 has just gathered the preceding figures.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate opposite vertical motions and group continuity; I infer an ethical relation in which granted height elicits lowering. Mere narrative succession without causal force remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Elevation risks sounding like autonomous superiority.
changed_reading.after: The elevation is bestowed height whose fitting expression is prostrating descent, not self-exaltation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ت ل ل target for a recitation occurrence and converts textual sequence into topography. It remains packet-resolvable and anchored by the focus place/high construction plus book and recitation cues. Downstream prose should mark it as a lexical activation, never as the ordinary meaning of the context word or as a final interpretation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 2-3 provide high place, while the publicity branch of word 1 permits textual prominence.

activation_trace.role: Public propagation allows elevation to occur in transmitted discourse.
Place or standing supplies the textual position being raised.
Vertical height supplies the outlier's topographic image.
Written composition supplies the textual field in which prominence can occur.
One voice following another supplies recitational transmission.
The non-dominant mapped target contributes a raised mound as an exploratory textual-spatial image.

changed_reading.before: The high place lies outside the discourse that reports it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the book and its recitation themselves form the raised textual prominence on which the figure is placed.

strongest_changes: Altitude opens into durable textual and public standing through 19:50 and 19:56.
The parallels in 19:52 and 19:55 recast height as privileged presence and approval.
The immediate fall and prostration of 19:58 make bestowed height coexist with embodied lowering.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly couples spatial vocabulary with status, speech, nearness, selection, and an immediate vertical reversal, so the focus supports several distinct mechanisms without requiring one final destination.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus does not force a choice between literal relocation, rank, memorial prominence, and privileged nearness.
The causal force of the 19:57-58 rise/fall juxtaposition is inferred rather than grammatically stated.
The textual-mound outlier depends on a non-dominant mapped root and must remain quarantined as exploratory.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 (19:41-58) - Guidance as Tracked and Truthful Transmission
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Guidance succeeds when a reliable message is marked, carried, followed, and fulfilled.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Guidance becomes a road-marker system, prophecy a clear road, and truthful reputation a durable public transmission.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Promise fulfilled into durable public reputation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A spoken commitment is completed in action and then persists as an elevated report on the tongue of others.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: truthful speech (`quranic:root_000852:B001/m01`); solid and straight truth (`quranic:root_000852:B002/m01`); complete and enduring reputation (`quranic:root_000852:B003/m01`); promise fulfilled in action (`quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`); promise opening expectation (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`); appointed time or place of fulfillment (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`); language, report, and praise on tongues (`quranic:root_001355:B006/m01`); raised and circulated report (`quranic:root_000582:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Truth is tested by temporal completion: promise opens an expectation, action closes it, and public speech preserves the result. The resulting "tongue of truth" is not mere fame but a durable relay of fulfilled conduct.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 (19:41-58) - Ordered Approach and Vertical Response
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Access to authority is choreographed through boundary, side, nearness, elevation, and bodily lowering.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The mountain behaves like a bounded court whose privileged audience is answered by opposite bodily vectors, raising and falling.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Raising answered by falling, bowing, and tears
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Honor lifts a person or station, while encounter with signs draws the body downward into prostration and tears.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: physical raising (`quranic:root_000582:B001/m01`); elevation of rank (`quranic:root_000582:B002/m01`); spatial height (`quranic:root_001042:B001/m01`); elevated honor (`quranic:root_001042:B002/m01`); downward fall with sound (`quranic:root_000402:B001/m01`); submission with forehead to ground (`quranic:root_000675:B001/m01`); bending under weight (`quranic:root_000675:B004/m01`); bodily bending gathered into prostration (`quranic:root_000220:B006/m01`); tears and voiced weeping (`quranic:root_000146:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 19:57 (ر ف ع, ك و ن, ع ل و); 19:58 (ج ب ي, خ ر ر, س ج د, ب ك ي)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The two verses create a deliberate vertical counterpoint. Rank and place rise; the recipient of signs falls. The descent is not loss of status but its bodily answer, completed by audible tears.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: well weight or stone tied to rope (`quranic:root_000547:B006/m01`); long tightly twisted draw-rope (`quranic:root_000796:B002/m01`); raised anvil or bucket fitting (`quranic:root_001042:B009/m01`); cord lifting a fetter (`quranic:root_000582:B009/m01`); one-handled water bucket (`quranic:root_000737:B011/m01`); bucket handle or balancing side-piece (`quranic:root_000741:B008/m01`)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişinin onurlu ve yüksek konumlu oluşunu, aşağılanmanın karşıtı olan saygınlığı ve bir anılışın ya da konumun yüceltilmesini aynı değer ekseninde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal toplumsal veya simgesel değerin yükselmesini kapsar; fiziksel taşıma ve yalnızca ün kazanma bu çekirdeğin yerini tutmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçimler yüksek saygınlık durumunu anlatır; anılışı, konumu, belgeleri veya yapıları yüceltmeye bağlı kalıplar ayrı bağlamsal gerçekleşmelerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin, anılışın veya konumun değer ve saygınlık bakımından yüksek olması ya da bu yüksek konuma çıkarılmasıdır. Aşağılanmanın karşıtıdır ve fiziksel yükseklik bildirmez.

facets.statement: Kişinin yüksek saygınlığa ve onurlu bir konuma sahip olması.
Bir kişinin, anılışın veya konumun saygınlığını artırıp onu yüceltmek.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar yüksek saygınlık ile aşağılanma arasındaki karşıtlığı temel alır; kişinin onurlu oluşunu ve anılış ya da konumun yüceltilmesini bu temel çevresinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem onurlu ve yüksek konumlu olma durumunu hem de birine ya da bir şeye bu değeri kazandırmayı kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Yüksek saygınlık durumunu ve bu duruma çıkarma işlemini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin sahip olduğu saygın konumu niteleyen durum kullanımı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin saygınlığını ve yüksek toplumsal değerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin, anılışın, belgenin veya yerin saygınlığının artırıldığı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Değeri ve saygınlığı etkin biçimde artırma yönünü korur.
Bir kişinin başkalarınca tanınması ihtimalini korur.
error_profile.loses: Onur, yüksek değer ve aşağılanmaya karşıt saygınlık çekirdeğini kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Saygınlık gerektirmeyen sıradan tanınmışlık anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Kötü bir nedenle tanınmış kişi de ünlü olabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yüksek toplumsal tabakayı ve seçkin kişileri adlandıran daha geniş kullanımları kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hem yüksek saygınlık durumunu hem de onu artırma eylemini işler; komşu dal yüksek onur alanını ve seçkinlik adlarını daha geniş biçimde kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişiyi küçümseyip değerini düşürür.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal değer ve onur kazandırırken komşu dal bunları azaltan küçümseme yönünde işler.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bineğin ağır yürüyüşten daha hızlı fakat tam koşudan daha düşük bir gidişini ve hayvanın yürüyüşünü belirgin biçimde hızlandırmayı birlikte gösterir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel hız kavramı değil, binek hayvanının belirli yoğunluk ve aralıkta gerçekleşen yürüyüş biçimidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Biçim birimleri belirli bir yürüyüş türünü adlandırır; kalıba bağlı kullanım ise bineğin yürüyüşünü bu düzeye çıkarma eylemini ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir binek hayvanının ağır yürüyüşten hızlı, tam koşudan daha düşük bir hızla güçlü biçimde ilerlemesidir. Aynı alan, hayvanın yürüyüşünü bu yoğunluğa çıkarma eylemini de kapsar.

facets.statement: Binek hayvanının ağır yürüyüş ile tam koşu arasında güçlü ve hızlı ilerlemesi.
Bineğin yürüyüşünü olağandan daha güçlü ve hızlı hale getirmek.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar bu yürüyüşü ağır gidişin üstünde, tam koşunun altında konumlandırır; bazı ifadeler hız aralığını, bazıları ise yürüyüşü artırma eylemini öne çıkarır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi genel yaklaştırma çekirdeğini açıkça verir ve kişi ya da anlatılan bir işi yönetici veya yargı yetkisi olan kimsenin önüne getirmeyi bunun kurumsal özel kullanımı olarak gösterir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçim yaklaştırmayı anlatır; kişiyi, davayı veya anlatılan işi bir yetkilinin önüne sunan kalıplar bu çekirdeğin kurumsal özel kullanımlarıdır.
